caption:
Figure 1: (a) A brief illustration of the current Grounding-DINO-based works. (b) We find that
compared with the ground-truth bounding box (red), for target domains, the top-ranked candidate
boxes (yellow) are less likely to tightly bound the objects, where the better candidate boxes (cyan)
may be ranked outside the Top-900 quota. Unlike current work, we identify the selected candidate
boxes as another bottleneck for the CD-FSOD task, which we aim to address in this paper.
delegated_acceptance_review: Viewed full derivative and reviewed all eight source-pair findings with caption/body evidence. Left original candidate-generation/semantic-score selection graph and all15 right comparison images retain their original labels, ranks, IoUs and box geometry. New red/yellow/cyan key agrees with explicit caption; Top900-to-decoder conclusion is source-grounded. No changes to measurement ranks or swapped example columns. Independent protected-region replay verifies original scientific evidence.
